/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by

namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin

  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && r.actor != r.target && !s.has r.target r.role then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })

  | .revoke =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && s.has r.target r.role &&

      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

  match r.op with
  | .grant =>

/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

        simp [hAny]

        simp [hNeAdmin]
    unfold Grants.step
    simp [hActCont, hTgtCont, hIsAdmin, hHas, hRevokeOk]

namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && r.actor != r.target && !s.has r.target r.role then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && s.has r.target r.role &&
        (r.role != .admin || s.users.any (fun v => v != r.target && s.has v .admin)) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance

  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && r.actor != r.target && !s.has r.target r.role then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && s.has r.target r.role &&
        (r.role != .admin || s.users.any (fun v => v != r.target && s.has v .admin)) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

def test_contains (s : State) (r : Request) (h : r.actor ∈ s.users) : s.users.contains r.actor = true := by
  simp_all

theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := sorry

theorem req_effects         : Effects step := sorry

  intro s r h
  cases r with | mk op actor target role =>
  cases op with
  | grant =>
    by_cases hA : actor ∈ s.users
    · by_cases hT : target ∈ s.users
      · by_cases hAd : s.has actor .admin = true
        · by_cases hNe : actor ≠ target
          · by_cases hNh : s.has target role = false
            · have hEq : step s { op := Op.grant, actor := actor, target := target, role := role } =
                (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == target && q == role then true else s.has u q }) := by

        · simp [Grants.step, isAdmin, hA, hT, hAd] at h

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && r.actor != r.target && !s.has r.target r.role then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && s.has r.target r.role &&
        (r.role != .admin || s.users.any (fun v => v != r.target && s.has v .admin)) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

  simp_all

instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && r.actor != r.target && !s.has r.target r.role then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && s.has r.target r.role &&
        (r.role != .admin || s.users.any (fun v => v != r.target && s.has v .admin)) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })

/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && r.actor != r.target && !s.has r.target r.role then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && s.has r.target r.role &&
        (r.role != .admin || s.users.any (fun v => v != r.target && s.has v .admin)) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

def test_contains (s : State) (r : Request) (h : r.actor ∈ s.users) : s.users.contains r.actor = true := by
  simp_all

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_authorization : AdminOnly step := by
  intro s r hOk
  simp [Grants.step, isAdmin] at hOk
  split at hOk
  next h => simp at hOk
  next h =>
    simp at h
    cases hOp : r.op with
    | grant =>
      simp [hOp] at hOk
      split at hOk
      next h2 => simp at hOk; exact ⟨h2.1.1.1, h2.1.1.2⟩
      next h2 => simp at hOk
    | revoke =>
      simp [hOp] at hOk
      split at hOk
      next h2 => simp at hOk; exact ⟨h2.1.1.1, h2.1.1.2⟩
      next h2 => simp at hOk

theorem req_no_self_grant : NoSelfGrant step := by
  intro s r hOk hGrant
  cases r with | mk op actor target role =>
  simp at hGrant
  subst hGrant
  simp [Grants.step] at hOk
  by_cases hcA : actor ∈ s.users
  · by_cases hcT : target ∈ s.users
    · simp [hcA, hcT] at hOk
      by_cases hCond : (isAdmin s actor = true ∧ ¬actor = target) ∧ s.has target role = false
      · exact hCond.1.2
      · simp [hCond] at hOk
    · simp [hcT] at hOk
  · simp [hcA] at hOk

theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := sorry

theorem req_effects         : Effects step := sorry

theorem req_idempotency : Idempotent step := by
  intro s r h
  cases r with | mk op actor target role =>
  cases op with
  | grant =>
    by_cases hA : actor ∈ s.users
    · by_cases hT : target ∈ s.users
      · by_cases hAd : s.has actor .admin = true
        · by_cases hNe : actor ≠ target
          · by_cases hNh : s.has target role = false
            · have hEq : step s { op := Op.grant, actor := actor, target := target, role := role } =

/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance
def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if !(s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target) then (.rejected, s) else
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && r.actor != r.target && !s.has r.target r.role then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if isAdmin s r.actor && s.has r.target r.role &&
        (r.role != .admin || s.users.any (fun v => v != r.target && s.has v .admin)) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

def test_contains (s : State) (r : Request) (h : r.actor ∈ s.users) : s.users.contains r.actor = true := by
  simp_all

theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry

  intro s r hOk
  simp [Grants.step, isAdmin] at hOk
  split at hOk
  next h => simp at hOk
  next h =>
    simp at h
    cases hOp : r.op with

      split at hOk
      next h2 => simp at hOk; exact ⟨h2.1.1.1, h2.1.1.2⟩
      next h2 => simp at hOk
    | revoke =>
      simp [hOp] at hOk
      split at hOk
      next h2 => simp at hOk; exact ⟨h2.1.1.1, h2.1.1.2⟩
